entities.name: Turntimber
entities.description: A vast temperate forest in central Ondu on Zendikar, named for its corkscrew-shaped trees.

entities.name: Tajuru Nation
entities.description: Elves whose Home Tree stands in Turntimber.

entities.name: Tajuru Home Tree
entities.description: Colossal moss-covered corkscrew tree housing several Tajuru villages.

entities.name: Mosscrack
entities.description: Tajuru settlement that fell during the emergence of the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrous beings whose emergence destroyed Mosscrack and whom Nissa first confronted in Turntimber.

entities.name: Graypelt
entities.description: Small community of druids, hunters and trailblazers on Turntimber's outskirts.

entities.name: Wolfbriar
entities.description: Shadowed glade deep in Turntimber, domain of Zalek.

entities.name: Zalek
entities.description: Elf beastmaster whose domain is Wolfbriar.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker of Joraga upbringing who studied with the Tajuru in Turntimber.

entities.name: Speaker Sutina
entities.description: Tajuru speaker whose death Nissa witnessed.

entities.name: Hiba
entities.description: Nissa's friend whose death she witnessed.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: Planeswalker Nissa joined on a journey to Graypelt.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: Companion who joined Nissa and Sorin on the journey to Graypelt.
